sources.extracted_facts: Title: Why Do Feet Hurt After Wearing Heels? Causes and Prevention Tips. Supplied keyword set: heels for women, heels, heel pain, high heels, high heels for women, transparent heels, heel pain causes, heel pain reason, heel pain treatment and heel pain remedy.

Possible symptom patterns include plantar fascia, Achilles, bursitis and injury-related pain. Guidance includes rest/elevation, wrapped ice up to 20 minutes every 2-3 hours, wide comfortable low-heeled shoes, soft soles, insoles/heel pads, avoiding high heels/tight pointy shoes, and explicit routine/urgent escalation criteria. Page says not to self-diagnose.

Pain is around the bottom of heel/arch and often worse on first steps after rest. Advice includes rest, ice, cushioned heels/arch support, insoles/heel pads, gentle exercises, and avoiding high heels/tight pointy shoes. Seek care if severe, worsening/recurrent, unchanged after two weeks, with sensory loss, or with diabetes.
AAOS explains plantar-fascia irritation/inflammation, heel-bottom symptoms, overuse and hard-surface standing, plus supportive footwear, rest, stretching and ice as conservative measures.

PubMed search record conclusion states that increased heel height resulted in increasing medial forefoot loading pressure. Direct page access returned reCAPTCHA, so the draft uses only that bounded conclusion and no sample or numerical claims.
